subject: NovaGrid trial access kickoff & gate plan
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Julie Taft <julie@novagrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: NovaGrid trial access kickoff & gate plan

Hi Julie — thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we provision anything:

Summary of what we heard
- Primary use case: internal docs search + assist for ops runbooks, peak latency target < 300ms p50 for short queries.
- Success criteria: 80% top-3 precision on your sample prompt set (you shared ~120 prompts), < $0.12 per 1k tokens modeled at expected volume, and SLO of 99.5% availability for the trial window.

Proposed trial / POC plan (2 weeks)
1) Day 0–1: Credentials & access: SSO invites for admin and 3 evaluators, API key for automated test harness, IP allowlist for your test runner.
2) Day 2–5: Baseline run — run your prompt set, collect metrics and sample outputs.
3) Day 6–9: One tuning iteration (prompt tweaks / context window changes) and rerun.
4) Day 10–14: Final acceptance window and wrap — decision on expansion or next steps.

What we need from you to start
- List of evaluator emails for SSO invites (admin + 3 evaluators)
- IP range(s) to add to our allowlist for the test runner (CIDR format preferred)
- Confirmation whether you want short-lived API key (preferred for automated runs) or SSO-only access

Logistics & owners
- Alex (me): trial coordinator / PL for Redwood side
- Rishi: infrastructure & provisioning (API keys, IP allowlist guidance)
- Marissa: success criteria tracking & evaluation dashboard wiring

Attachments: we’ll attach a short IP allowlist guide and a CSV template for user list (see attached).

If that all looks good, we’ll provision a staging API key and SSO invites by EOD tomorrow once you send the email list and IP ranges.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187

Alex — this looks good, thanks for the clear plan. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) Evaluators: please invite julie@novagrid.com (admin), martin@novagrid.com, sarah.ops@novagrid.com, and ops-runner@novagrid.com.
2) IP allowlist: our test runner sits behind our CI pool — add 203.0.113.0/27 and 198.51.100.128/25. We’ll double-check with infra if more ranges are needed.
3) API key vs SSO: prefer short-lived API key for the automated harness (rotate every 24 hours) plus SSO for human evaluators. Can you confirm rotation/TTL options?

Also: curious if you can support a test where we stream partial results into our UI — we’ll want websocket/stream compatibility.

Thanks — Julie

julie@novagrid.com

Hi all — looping in infra details and what I’ll provision once we have the final list. Short answers up front:

- Short-lived API keys: we can issue keys with TTLs down to 1 hour and automated rotation via our control plane. For the CI runner your ask (24h rotation) is straightforward; we’ll issue a script that hits the rotation endpoint.
- Streaming: Redwood supports chunked streaming over server-sent events and gRPC streaming for our private deployments; the hosted API supports SSE for partial tokens. We’ll send a sample curl and a node example for SSE.
- IP allowlist: I’ll add 203.0.113.0/27 and 198.51.100.128/25 once confirmed. If NovaGrid needs additional ranges for outbound NAT, send them.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood-ip-allowlist-guide.pdf (PDF, 120KB) — steps for allowlisting and firewall notes
- nova-internal-userlist.csv (CSV) — template for the SSO invite payload (email, role, team)

Provisioning plan (what I’ll do once I have the CSV + CIDRs):
1) Create a trial org (NovaGrid-staging) and generate one short-lived API key tied to trial org
2) Stage keys in a sandbox project and add the CI IP ranges to the trial org allowlist
3) Send SSO invites (SAML) — note: if your IdP requires SCIM user provisioning we’ll need an additional config step; otherwise we can do invites by email
4) Share a test key + sample SSE streaming snippet for your engineers to wire into the UI

I’ll prepare the rotation script and the sample code and attach them in my follow-up.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
